notes.title: Clarifying the future of Eight
notes.notes:
We are absolutely honoured that so many of you played Eight and left a review or feedback. It was a blast seeing people make let's plays and commentary video's on the internet.

This project was part of an experiment to test out a new work methodology. [b]This means that Eight will not receive any updates[/b]. We have read all your feedback and will take it into account in future projects. If you are curious to see what else we are working on make sure to check our website.
